title: Whole-source lexical worksheet with three optional transparent spellings

budget.scope: Includes predecessor/profile review, manual authoring, source verification and publication. No decoder, new census or control corpus.

positive_basis: 852 same-line split/join spacing contrast;1201 conditional transparent-chunk principle
Existing profiles for ol/qol/chedy and compounds; directed parts and wholeform distinctions retained
strongest_countercases: R771/1386 formal compatibility does not identify semantics; free Class assignments and operators remain unbound
853 interword context comparison lacked capacity; no claim of semantic interchangeability
1320/1333 concern within-group working-unit fusion, not lexical space choice
1390 searchfailure and1326/1391 narrow formatter exclusions do not reject source-chosen words
decision_note.unknown: Whether the literal whole-source account can express the proposed common lexical identity without smuggling grammar, referents, omitted repeats or wider prefix rules. It is not a truth/meaning selection test.
decision_note.outcome_changes: Produce a concrete comparison worksheet for continued lexical work if exact accounting succeeds; stop if the authoring requires extra entries, token loss, invented consumers or exceptions. Success is a representation, not evidence for the identity hypothesis.

rule.status: UNASSESSED_LEXICAL_IDENTITY_HYPOTHESIS; no meaning assigned and no claim components are confirmed morphemes
rule.all_other_groups: Retain exact raw whole as an atomic UNASSIGNED form; no default Class/Command/Entity role. Includes raw c and marked forms.
rule.order: Preserve order and occurrence multiplicity. No semantic reset or event coalescence.
rule.surface: Preserve each raw source group, original ID, literal separators and line metadata. Expanded items share their source-group ID. Joining is a paid surface-choice flag, not explained by a random coin or grammatical consumer.
rule.joining_scope: Only the three exact whole strings. Do not split arbitrary ol/qol prefixes, e/d/y, or embedded strings elsewhere.
rule.boundaries: Source-expression identity across the declared joined/split forms is proposed, not observed. The diplomatic spacing remains primary; normalizing it does not prove equal content or attachment.

scope.comparison: IT2a f75r.32–46, all120rawgroups; already exposed, samefolio, not holdout
scope.reader_policy: This authoring unit selects IT explicitly for a readable comparison; no pooled readers or claim of independent confirmation. Other readings/marked variants stay in prior source records.
scope.input: C1064_DERIVATION_20261016.json with original guarded sources verified independently

deliverables: Full diplomatic and proposed expanded text for both complete passages
Exact occurrence/atom accounting and three optional-join flags; repeated forms reuse same anonymous ID
Explicit comparison with R771: no assertion/restriction or reference meaning inferred from spacing
Remaining semantic and lexical obligations, not another missing-input registry or statistical test
pre_authoring_capacity_note: The fixed f75r IT comparison contains none of the three declared joined forms, as independently checked before worksheet execution. It cannot test transfer of joining; it supplies only complete exposed comparison context. Do not promote unchanged coverage to a transfer success.
